title: Precision Refinement of 24-Layer Stack with Reduced Perturbation Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing thickness perturbation amplitude by approximately 50% around the iteration 09 best candidate (thicknesses: [123, 90, 122, 90, 136, 168, 98, 157, 116, 140, 111, 91, 153, 90, 118, 140, 129, 90, 119, 155, 112, 90, 121, 117] nm) will enable finer convergence to local optimum while maintaining the verified alternating HfO2/SiO2 topology.
design_principle: Lock layer ordering to alternating HfO2/SiO2 sequence starting with HfO2 on substrate. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with bounds ±20nm around iteration 09 best candidate instead of wider search ranges. This transitions from coarse sweeping to precision refinement.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate (24 finite layers total, 12 bilayers)
design_variables: layer thicknesses (24 variables, bounded ±20nm around iteration 09 best candidate)
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: alternating order locked to prevent deposition sequence errors
thickness tolerance analysis with ±5% relative uniform error
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflectance bands
Needle optimization principle for non-quarter-wave refinement
expected_advantages: Finer convergence to local optimum compared to iteration 09
Maintained topological stability from locked layer ordering
known_risks: May converge to local rather than global optimum
Reduced search space may miss better solutions outside ±20nm bounds
Robustness score may not improve if solution is already at stability limit
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer dielectric coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence using alternating HfO2 and SiO2 layers. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (24 finite layers, starting with HfO2 on substrate, ending with SiO2 at air interface). Initialize thicknesses at [123, 90, 122, 90, 136, 168, 98, 157, 116, 140, 111, 91, 153, 90, 118, 140, 129, 90, 119, 155, 112, 90, 121, 117] nm from iteration 09 best candidate. Apply gradient_thickness optimizer with bounds ±20nm around initialization. Evaluate over 300-450 nm and 1000-1700 nm wavelength bands at normal incidence. Maximize transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and reflectance in 300-450 nm band simultaneously. Use coherent smatrix solver. Include ±5% relative uniform thickness tolerance robustness analysis. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Reduced perturbation bounds from iteration 09 wide search to ±20nm precision refinement per feedback directive. Locked alternating HfO2/SiO2 ordering to prevent topological drift. Initialized from iteration 09 best candidate thicknesses.
